description: DNSSEC status for a domain using Cloudflare's public resolver (1.1.1.1 DNS-over-HTTPS): whether the resolver validated the answer (AD flag), the DS records in the parent zone, and the DNSKEY records with key-signing keys. The validation is done by Cloudflare's resolver, not by this tool walking the chain to the root. Related tools on this server, for a different need: agent_intel_cross_chain_bridge_liquidity when you need across bridge limits for USDC between two chains; agent_intel_eu_vies_vat_batch_validator when you need to check up to 5 EU VAT numbers with the European. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

domain.description: Domain such as ietf.org (a URL is reduced to its host)
